title: Chemical Equations and Conservation of Mass
requiredLabVisualSimulationEvidence: Conservation and balancing model analysis using atom inventory tables. PhET balancing may be used only as an assigned virtual resource.
simulationVirtualLabReviewRequirement: Required for balancing equations, conservation, mole/stoichiometry, and reaction classification
directSimulationStudentTask: After the simulation opens, start with the introduction or balance-equation screen. Select one equation from the lesson activity and change coefficients only, not subscripts. Turn on atom counts, bar charts, or balance indicators if those tools are available. Record the unbalanced equation, final coefficients, atom counts on both sides, and the conservation rule shown by the model.
simulationReviewImplementation: Student-facing lesson includes one exact direct simulation/resource link plus adjacent step-by-step directions for what to open, click/use, observe, record, and connect to the lesson standard.
